resale_co.name: Certificate of Approval for Resale (also called Continued Certificate of Occupancy)
resale_co.issued_by: Township of Wyckoff Construction Official (Building, Zoning and Property Maintenance), with inspections by the Tax Assessor, Water Department and Board of Health as needed
resale_co.lead_time: Issued or denied within 10 days of filing. The fee is lowest when the request is received more than 10 business days before the change of occupancy. The Township suggests planning the inspection at least two weeks before closing; inspections are Monday to Friday, 10am to 3pm, and the resale and smoke inspections are usually set for the same date.
resale_co.valid_for: 120 days from the date of issuance
requirements: Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors installed
Handrails on all stairways with three or more risers
Sump pumps proven not to discharge into the sanitary sewer
All open construction permits closed, and permits on file for newly installed items (furnace, water heater, roof, siding, finished basement, kitchen and bath, electrical and plumbing work)
Sidewalks and driveways in the public right-of-way in good condition
House numbers visible from the street
General compliance with the property maintenance and zoning codes
Homes not on municipal sewer: septic system tested and report reviewed by the Construction Official, Township Engineer and Board of Health; cesspools must comply with N.J.A.C. 7:9A-3.16
An adult must be present to give the inspector access; all inspection correspondence is by email

fees.label: Certificate of approval for resale, 1 or 2 family, request received more than 10 business days before the change of occupancy
fees.quote: Requests for certificate of approval for resale received more than ten (10) business days prior to the change of occupancy: $160.

fees.label: Certificate of approval for resale, 1 or 2 family, request received 4 to 10 business days before
fees.quote: Requests for certificate of approval for resale received four (4) to ten (10) business days prior to the change of occupancy: $240.

fees.label: Certificate of approval for resale, 1 or 2 family, request received fewer than 4 business days before
fees.quote: Requests for certificate of approval for resale received fewer than four (4) business days prior to the change of occupant: $300.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Apply online with the Township's Application for Certificate of Approval at Resale (SeamlessDocs form linked from the Building Department Forms and Applications page), choose septic or sewer and whether the buyer will occupy, and pay the inspection fee. Apply for the smoke detector certificate separately (GovPilot) and pick the same inspection date for both. Questions: Building, Zoning and Property Maintenance, 340 Franklin Avenue, (201) 891-7000 ext. 3060.
resale_co.contact_title: Building, Zoning and Property Maintenance Department

evidence.quote: Transfer of title to real property containing a building, structure of any kind, or sidewalks.
A certificate of approval for resale shall be deemed valid for 120 days from the date of issuance.
The responsibility for obtaining a certificate of approval for resale rests with the current owner of the property.
Wyckoff requires a Certificate of Compliance (for (1) smoke and carbon monoxide detector inspection and (2) a Continued Certificate of Occupancy) prior to the sale closing or rental of the property.
It is best to plan for this inspection at least two weeks prior to the closing.
Both the Certificate of Approval for Resale and the Smoke Detector Certificate inspections will take place in the same timeframe.

resale_co.notes: Code Chapter 94, Article I (Certificate of Approval for Resale, adopted 4-3-2012 by Ord. No. 1685, rewritten 8-22-2017 by Ord. No. 1840, fees amended 8-17-2021 by Ord. No. 1946) was read through the ecode360 print view. Exempt transfers: deed corrections, ancient deeds, between husband and wife, and between owners and children. Failure to obtain the certificate can bring a fine of up to $500. The Township's tax searches carry a notice that the certificate is required. The online form lists the Township Clerk email wyckoffclerk@wyckoffnj.gov and 201-891-7000. Short-term rentals are prohibited (Chapter 144), not a resale item.

requirements: One smoke detector in the basement and on each floor (unfinished attics excluded), and within 10 feet of the doorway of bedrooms on any floor with bedrooms
Battery smoke detectors must be 10-year sealed lithium units; all smoke detectors less than 10 years old and ANSI/UL 217 listed; hardwired detectors stay hardwired
Carbon monoxide detectors within 10 feet of the bedrooms (outside the bedroom), less than 10 years old, UL 2034 listed
Low voltage or monitored alarm systems must be tested/serviced first, with a report from the alarm company available at the inspection

Fire extinguisher 2A:10BC, no more than 10 lbs, listed, labeled, charged and operable, brand new with receipt or tagged within 12 months, present on the main level with mounting hardware and instructions left for the new owner (form still lists it)

Secondary power source warning label (for example 'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER') within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and meter if the home has a generator, solar panels or battery storage

authorities.name: Wyckoff Fire Prevention Bureau
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on business days between scheduling and the inspection date: 10 or more business days for the lowest fee. Fees must be paid before the inspection.

fees.label: Smoke, CO and fire extinguisher inspection scheduled 10 business days or more before the inspection date
fees.quote: $90.00 –   IF SCHEDULED 10 BUSINESS DAYS OR MORE PRIOR TO INSPECTION DATE.

fees.label: Inspection scheduled 4 to 10 business days before
fees.quote: $145.00 –   IF SCHEDULED 4-10 BUSINESS DAYS PRIOR TO INSPECTION DATE.

fees.label: Inspection scheduled 3 business days or less before
fees.quote: $205.00 –   IF SCHEDULED 3 BUSINESS DAYS OR LESS PRIOR TO INSPECTION DATE.

fees.label: Re-inspection
fees.quote: **$75.00 – Fee will be charged for ALL re-inspections.

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply and pay online with the Township's Smoke Alarm application (GovPilot), or pay in person at Town Hall, 340 Franklin Avenue. Schedule the same date as the resale inspection.

evidence.quote: INSPECTION FEES MUST BE PAID PRIOR TO INSPECTION ONLINE OR IN PERSON
A resale certificate inspection is also required per Township of Wyckoff Ordinance for all sales.
Shall be brand new with receipt or tagged by a licensed fire protection company within the last 12 months.
LEAID: 0270-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official Edward Lawler Phone (201) 891-7000

fire_cert.notes: The Fire Prevention page and the June 2026 requirements sheet still require a 2A:10BC fire extinguisher for a home sale, although state law (P.L.2025, c.19) removed it from the sale certificate in February 2025; confirm with the Fire Prevention Bureau. The NJ DCA directory lists the Fire Official as Edward Lawler, ejlawler@wyckoffnj.gov; the Township's own sheet uses elawler@wyckoffnj.gov. The page also adds the secondary power source label requirement.

other_items.label: Septic system test (homes not on municipal sewer)
other_items.detail: Homes not served by municipal sewer must have the septic system tested and the report reviewed by the Construction Official, Township Engineer and Board of Health before the resale certificate; cesspools must be dealt with under N.J.A.C. 7:9A-3.16.

other_items.label: Sump pump discharge
other_items.detail: Sump pumps must be proven not to discharge into the sanitary sewer.

other_items.label: Sidewalks and driveway aprons
other_items.detail: Sidewalks and driveways in the public right-of-way must be in good condition for the resale certificate.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: All open construction permits must be closed, and recent work (furnace, water heater, roof, siding, finished basement, kitchen, bath, electrical, plumbing) must have had permits.

other_items.label: Water Department and Tax Assessor inspection
other_items.detail: The resale inspection may include the Tax Assessor and Water Department (for example a final meter check); confirm with the Township.

open_questions: Does Wyckoff still require the fire extinguisher at resale after P.L.2025, c.19?
Is a separate final water meter reading required from the Water Department before closing?
Is the fire certificate valid for a set period before closing?
